name: MCP Tools
description: Installs MCP helper tools for Agentic Workspace, starting with a ready-to-use Playwright MCP config for shared browser automation.

playwright_cdp_endpoint.description: CDP endpoint used by Playwright MCP for the shared AW browser from inside the MCP Gateway container.

tool_playwright_enabled.title: Playwright
tool_playwright_enabled.description: Shared-browser Playwright MCP tools (browser_navigate, browser_click, browser_snapshot, ...). Disabling removes them from the MCP Gateway's tools/list on the next save.

tool_echo_enabled.title: Echo (test tool)
tool_echo_enabled.description: Temporary test tool for trying the enable/disable toggle end to end — safe to disable or remove.

apps.reason: MCP Tools contributes mcp.json definitions that are discovered and merged by the MCP Gateway app.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace installs/loads mcp-gateway before mcp-tools so the gateway can scan mcp-tools/mcp.json.
